name: gi-training-planning-and-startup-reliefs
description: Gibraltar business tax relief reference covering approved qualifying training, architects and planning fees, and the closed entry window for the historic start-up credit. Distinguishes enhanced deductions from tax credits, approval from automatic eligibility, and period-specific measures from current claims. Includes recomputable deduction and credit examples and evidence controls. Based on Schedule 3 of the Income Tax Act consolidation dated March 2026, checked in October 2026. Does not catalogue all incentives or certify claim approval; independent review is pending. Use for 2026 employer and self-employed working papers.
